u0: No siren has rung without the switch later being flipped, so nothing is owed yet; the agent may move freely through the room. If the siren rings now without a flip on the same step, an obligation begins. Reaching the exit while nothing is owed satisfies the requirement.
u1: A switch flip has occurred, and either the siren never rang or its ring was answered by that flip, so the requirement is satisfied. Nothing further needs to be done for the siren; the agent is free to reach the exit, and no failure is possible at this point.
u2: The siren is ringing and has not yet been answered by a switch flip, so the agent owes at least one flip before the run ends. The agent must reach the switch and toggle it to clear the obligation; flipping it at any later point completes the requirement and returns to the satisfied situation.
